title: EXCEPT removes a row and all its duplicates when it appears in the right table

source.quote: If a row appears at all in both tables, it and its duplicates are not present in the result set.
source.supports: the page shows these two tables (States1, States2) and this result

derivation: Left: A, B, B, B, C, D, D. B, C, D are in the right table, so every copy goes. Only A is left.
